method: Checked out origin/cursor/p2-loop-to-green-0db0 at tip 7614edeac (AUD-0054 commit), created cursor/aud-0054-review-0db0 from it. Read the receipt (command-center/audit/AUD-0054-platform-conditional-tests.json) and all three probe scripts (probe1_ast_platform_skips.py, probe2_collect_vs_execute.py, control_probe_independence.py) plus the fixture (fixtures/test_control_runtime_only_skip.py) without treating the headline prose as authoritative. Independently re-ran `python3 -B .../control_probe_independence.py`, `python3 -B .../probe1_ast_platform_skips.py`, and `python3 -B .../probe2_collect_vs_execute.py` from a clean tree, comparing regenerated JSON/raw output byte-for-byte against the committed artifacts (diff showed only measured_at timestamps, a files_scanned drift of 3017->3020 from unrelated upstream commits landing between receipt creation and this review, and sub-millisecond pytest timing noise -- zero count/classification/row changes). Reverted all probe-output mutations with `git checkout --` before doing anything else, per the non-negotiables. Independently spot-checked 6 of the 8 declared platform-gated rows by reading the actual source at the cited path:lineno (hooks/file-scope/test_file_scope.py:172/179/186/306, hooks/precompact-snapshot/test_snapshot.py:89 via the same-file `windows_only` variable at L48, platform/coordination/test_leases.py:100+120 via the cross-file `_CASE_INSENSITIVE_FS` constant imported from platform/coordination/leases.py:71) and confirmed each condition text and required_platform classification against the AST scan's own reported resolution path. Independently verified the CI-matrix premise with `grep -rhoE "runs-on:\s*.+" .github/workflows/*.yml | sort | uniq -c`, which returned exactly `19 runs-on: ubuntu-latest` and zero non-linux runners, matching AUD-0049's linux-only exercised_families claim that AUD-0054 depends on. Independently inspected all 8 excluded_tool_presence_examples rows to check whether the tool-presence exclusion heuristic was hiding a real platform-conditional skip that should have counted toward windows_only/posix_only; found none (4 are genuine tool-presence-only gates -- git, pwsh, PWSH, rapidocr_onnxruntime -- with no textual platform predicate, and 4 are false-positive matches on unrelated module-level string/list literals named MUTATIONS/NEW_ARM/FARSIDE_TOOL/COMPLEX_PY that happen to contain the substring 'is None' inside multi-line text blobs, not skipif decorators at all). Attempted to break probe2's reproducibility from a genuinely fresh environment: my first run of probe2 returned total_skipped_here=8, runtime_only_hits=1, control_ok=False because `tools/agentrail/tests/test_deploy.py` failed to collect (ModuleNotFoundError: agentspec, then agentrail) in this checkout, which had neither of the two in-repo sibling packages pip-installed. After `pip install --break-system-packages -e tools/agentspec` and `-e tools/agentrail` (the exact setup tools/agentrail/pyproject.toml's own comments document as required for `RUNTIME / tests`), the re-run reproduced total_skipped_here=9, declared_hits=7, runtime_only_hits=2, control_ok=True exactly. Verified receipt.state and receipt.reviewer.verdict were unchanged (BLOCKED / NOT-REVIEWED) both before and after all probe re-runs, and that `git status --short` on the probe directory was clean before writing this file. Did not run _pack_receipt.py, and made no edits to the receipt or any probe script.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Re-derive windows_only/posix_only/windows_or_darwin_only/linux_case_sensitive_only counts from a fresh probe1 run rather than trusting the committed probe1-ast-platform-skips.json.
falsification_attempts.detail: Fresh run: files_scanned=3020 (was 3017; +3 from unrelated commits), platform_gated_test_rows=8, by_required_platform={'windows-only': 6, 'windows-or-darwin-only': 1, 'linux-case-sensitive-only': 1}, never_on_current_ci_matrix_declared_count=7, control_runtime_only_fixture_correctly_missed=True. Every count and every row (path:lineno:target:condition_text:required_platform) is byte-identical to the committed artifact except the file-count drift, which is attributable to sibling commits and does not touch any of the 8 platform-gated rows.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Re-derive the collect-vs-execute diff from a fresh probe2 run in a genuinely clean environment (no assumption that the receipt author's Python environment matches mine) to see if runtime_only_hits=2 / combined_never_on_current_ci_matrix=9 survives a truly independent execution.
falsification_attempts.detail: First run (no packages installed beyond stdlib + pytest) returned total_skipped_here=8, runtime_only_hits=1, control_ok=False: tools/agentrail/tests/test_deploy.py failed to collect (rc=4, ImportError -> ModuleNotFoundError: agentspec; after installing agentspec, ModuleNotFoundError: agentrail). This is a genuine reproducibility gap -- the probe's own docstring does not state the pip-install prerequisite, though tools/agentrail/pyproject.toml itself documents it (`RUNTIME / tests -> pip install -e ../agentspec`). After `pip install --break-system-packages -e tools/agentspec` and `-e tools/agentrail`, the re-run reproduced total_skipped_here=9, declared_hits=7, runtime_only_hits=2, control_ok=True exactly, matching the committed artifact byte-for-byte on every count. The headline claim is correct on this Linux host once its stated (if under-documented) setup is satisfied; it does not survive on an under-provisioned checkout, which is a documentation/robustness note, not a falsification of the measured claim.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Attempt to collapse probe1/probe2 independence: check whether either runtime-only case (hermetic fixture, real production test_deploy.py case) is ALSO found by probe1's AST scan, which would mean the two probes are not independent.
falsification_attempts.detail: Fresh control_probe_independence.py run: hermetic-fixture found_by_probe1=False found_by_probe2=True independent=True; real-production-test found_by_probe1=False found_by_probe2=True independent=True; all_ok=True. Manually confirmed by grepping probe1's own 8-row output for both test names (test_control_windows_only_runtime_skip_no_decorator, test_the_rendered_shim_really_propagates_a_nonzero_exit) -- neither appears, because both skips are body-level `pytest.skip()` calls with zero `@pytest.mark.skipif`/`skip`/`unittest.skipIf` decorator, which probe1 is structurally blind to by design.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Check whether the tool-presence exclusion heuristic (excluded_tool_presence_count=8) is silently dropping a genuine platform-conditional skip out of the windows_only/posix_only counts, which would make those counts an undercount.
falsification_attempts.detail: Read all 8 excluded_tool_presence_examples rows. None contain a textual platform predicate (sys.platform / os.name / platform.system()) alongside the 'is None' tool-presence pattern -- 4 are legitimate tool-presence-only skipif conditions (BASH/git/PWSH/rapidocr_onnxruntime is None) and 4 are false-positive matches against unrelated module-level string/list literals (MUTATIONS, NEW_ARM, FARSIDE_TOOL, COMPLEX_PY) that are not skipif decorators at all. The heuristic is over-inclusive (noisy), not under-inclusive, so no windows_only/posix_only row is hidden by this exclusion.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Independently re-derive the 'CI exercises only linux' premise that the never_on_current_ci_matrix classification depends on, rather than trusting AUD-0049's stated summary.
falsification_attempts.detail: `grep -rhoE "runs-on:\s*.+" .github/workflows/*.yml | sort | uniq -c` returned exactly `19 runs-on: ubuntu-latest` with zero windows-latest/macos-latest/matrix.os entries in any of the 12 workflow files, confirming AUD-0049's exercised_families=['linux'] claim that AUD-0054's never_on_current_ci_matrix labels are built on.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Spot-check individual source lines for at least 3 of the 6 windows_only rows plus the windows_or_darwin_only and linux_case_sensitive_only rows, to catch a misclassification (e.g. a negated condition read as non-negated, or a posix-only condition mislabeled windows-only).
falsification_attempts.detail: Read hooks/file-scope/test_file_scope.py:172,179,186,306 (each `@pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != "nt", ...)` -- correctly windows-only, never-on-linux-CI); hooks/precompact-snapshot/test_snapshot.py:48-89 (module-level `windows_only = pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform != "win32" or shutil.which("pwsh") is None, ...)`, correctly resolved one hop through the shared decorator variable, correctly windows-only); platform/coordination/leases.py:71 (`_CASE_INSENSITIVE_FS = sys.platform in {"win32", "darwin"}`) cross-referenced against test_leases.py:100 (`skipif(not _CASE_INSENSITIVE_FS, ...)` -> executes only on win32/darwin -> correctly windows-or-darwin-only, never-on-linux-CI) and test_leases.py:120 (`skipif(_CASE_INSENSITIVE_FS, ...)` -> executes only on linux -> correctly linux-case-sensitive-only, on-current-CI). All classifications matched the probe's own labels exactly.

probe1_ast_platform_skips.diff_from_committed: measured_at timestamp and files_scanned (3017 -> 3020, unrelated upstream commits); zero row/count/classification differences

probe2_collect_vs_execute.first_attempt_note: ran with no packages installed: tools/agentrail/tests/test_deploy.py failed to import (agentspec then agentrail ModuleNotFoundError), yielding total_skipped_here=8 runtime_only_hits=1 control_ok=False
probe2_collect_vs_execute.env_fix: pip install --break-system-packages -e tools/agentspec && pip install --break-system-packages -e tools/agentrail
probe2_collect_vs_execute.diff_from_committed: measured_at timestamp and sub-second pytest timing text only; zero count differences after installing the two documented sibling packages

re_runs.tracked_output_mutation_handling: probe1-ast-platform-skips.json/.raw.txt, probe2-collect-vs-execute.json/.raw.txt, and control-probe-independence.json/.raw.txt were regenerated in-place by the above re-runs (they are tracked files); diffed against HEAD, confirmed only cosmetic differences (timestamps, files_scanned drift, pytest timing text), then reverted with `git checkout -- command-center/p2-wave/probes/AUD-0054/` before proceeding, per instructions. `git status --short` was clean immediately before writing this review file.

notes: All headline counts and the probe-independence control survived every falsification attempt made in this review. The one genuine issue found -- probe2's collect-vs-execute diff for tools/agentrail/tests/test_deploy.py silently depends on two in-repo sibling packages (agentspec, agentrail) being pip-installed editable, which is not stated in probe2's own docstring even though tools/agentrail/pyproject.toml documents the requirement -- is an environment-reproducibility gap, not a defect in the measured claim: once the documented setup is applied, probe2 reproduces the committed artifact's total_skipped_here=9/declared_hits=7/runtime_only_hits=2/control_ok=True exactly, with no count drift. A second minor, non-blocking observation: 4 of the 8 excluded_tool_presence_examples entries are heuristic false positives (unrelated module-level string/list literals matched on the substring 'is None', not actual skipif decorators), meaning that diagnostic sub-count is noisier than its name implies -- but this over-inclusion cannot hide a real platform-conditional test from the windows_only/posix_only/etc. counts, and I confirmed by direct inspection that none of the 8 excluded rows contain a genuine platform predicate. Neither finding changes the verdict on the audited headline claims. Per instructions, the receipt was left untouched at state=BLOCKED, reviewer.verdict=NOT-REVIEWED; no promotion, no _pack_receipt.py execution, and no edits to any probe script or the receipt itself.
residual_unknowns: Not independently verified: whether every declared windows-only / windows-or-darwin-only test would actually PASS (not just execute) on a real Windows or macOS runner -- this review, like the receipt itself, only had a Linux execution substrate available and did not attempt cross-platform execution.

Not independently verified: whether the tool-presence exclusion heuristic's false positives (MUTATIONS/NEW_ARM/FARSIDE_TOOL/COMPLEX_PY literal matches) also exist elsewhere in the 3020-file scan without being surfaced in the truncated excluded_tool_presence_examples[:10] list; the full excluded set was not enumerated, only the 8 examples the receipt itself lists.

Not independently verified: exhaustive absence of a third platform-gate form (custom fixture calling skip(), or class-level pytestmark list) across the whole repository -- this review relied on probe1's own stated scope (decorator-only) and probe2's 5-file scope, matching the receipt's own residual_unknowns rather than extending the search.
